modules.mod_irc.irc_servers.description: List of IRC server hostnames to connect to by default.

modules.mod_irc.irc_use_pubsub.description: If true, use PubSub for IRC channel state synchronization (requires ejabberd_pubsub).

modules.mod_irc.irc_use_privmsg.description: If true, route private messages through IRC; otherwise, use direct IRC queries.

modules.mod_irc.irc_use_ircbridge.description: If true, integrate with ircbridge (a separate IRC-Jabber bridge service).

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.port.description: Default port for IRC server connections (6667 = non-SSL, 6697 = common SSL port).

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.use_s.description: Use TLS/SSL for connections to IRC servers.

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.ssl_o.description: Fail SSL handshake if peer does not present a certificate (only relevant if verify='peer').

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.passw.description: Global IRC password (server authentication); leave blank for none.

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.chars.description: Character set used for encoding/decoding IRC messages.

modules.mod_irc.irc_default_server.usern.description: If true, use the user’s full JID (local part) as their IRC nickname.

modules.mod_irc.irc_server_options.description: Per-server configuration overrides. Each entry specifies host-specific settings that take precedence over defaults.

items.description: Override configuration for one IRC server.

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL for this server (overrides default).

username.description: IRC username for this server (overrides default).

charset.description: Character set for this server (overrides default).

realname.description: Real name for this server (overrides default).

username_as_nick.description: Use username as nick for this server (overrides default).
